page_title: BOU 1-1 SUN | Bournemouth v Sunderland 28/02/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+13' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+12' The corner from Alex Scott (Bournemouth) is intercepted by Robin Roefs.
90+12' Amine Adli (Bournemouth) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger. Bournemouth have been awarded a corner kick.
90+10' Enes Unal (Bournemouth) finds space inside the box to shoot after collecting a short pass, but it's a wasted effort as it flies high over the bar.
90+9' Marcos Senesi (Bournemouth) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
90+9' Foul! Enzo Le Fee (Sunderland) is penalised for pulling back his opponent.
90+6' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Wilson Isidor (Sunderland) will replace Eliezer Mayenda.
90+5' The foul by Alex Scott (Bournemouth) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Jarred Gillett.
90+3' Alex Scott (Bournemouth) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.
90+3' Alex Toth (Bournemouth) receives a sweet pass inside the box, but his effort on goal is blocked by the defender. Bournemouth win a corner.
90' There will be a minimum of 8 min. of added time.
90' Jarred Gillett shows a yellow card to Ryan Christie (Bournemouth) for his blatant foul.
89' Enes Unal (Bournemouth) collects a brilliant pass inside the box and finds himself in a goal scoring opportunity. He takes a shot, but the effort is well blocked by one of the defending players.
89' Alejandro Jimenez (Bournemouth) plays in a hopeful cross, but it doesn't find its way to any of the attacking players.
87' The attendance is 11240.
86' Alex Toth (Bournemouth) sees a yellow card from Jarred Gillett after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.
85' Andoni Iraola has decided to substitute Evanilson and he is replaced by Alex Toth (Bournemouth).
84' Robin Roefs leaps to collect the ball from the corner which was sent over by Alex Scott (Bournemouth).
82' Sunderland have a goal ruled out for offside!
81' Substitution. Marcus Tavernier makes way for Amine Adli (Bournemouth).
81' Andoni Iraola prepares a substitution. Eli Junior Kroupi is replaced by Enes Unal (Bournemouth).

78' Daniel Ballard (Sunderland) reacts well near the penalty spot to connect with the resulting corner, but fails to direct his header into the back of the net. The ball goes well wide of the right post.
78' The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Bournemouth.
76' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Nilson Angulo (Sunderland) comes onto the pitch so that Granit Xhaka can be given a rest.
75' Noah Sadiki (Sunderland) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass.
74' Robin Roefs (Sunderland) will have to be careful for the rest of the match as he is shown a yellow card.
74' That was close by Alex Scott (Bournemouth)! He receives a pass on the edge of the box and shoots, but the ball goes inches wide of the right post.

72' What a miss! Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth) is left standing right in front of goal with only the keeper to beat after a clever pass, but he somehow contrives to toe poke the ball just past the right post.
70' Alejandro Jimenez (Bournemouth) receives a precise pass on the edge of the box and releases a promising effort. Unfortunately for him, his strike flies painfully close to the right post.
69' That's the end of the game for Chemsdine Talbi, who is replaced by Bertrand Traore (Sunderland).
66' Adrien Truffert (Bournemouth) commits a rough foul. Jarred Gillett stops the game and makes a call.
66' Jarred Gillett sticks with his original decision after the VAR review. No infringement and the goal stands!
65' The Bournemouth players halt their celebrations as referee Jarred Gillett makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was a handball in the build-up play.
63' 1 - 1 Evanilson (Bournemouth) scores a goal! He converts a superb cross into the box with a great header. The ball goes in off the crossbar. Truly outstanding goal!
62' Substitution. Tyler Adams makes his way off the pitch and Ryan Christie (Bournemouth) comes on as his replacement.
62' An attempted cross from Adrien Truffert (Bournemouth) is cleared.
60' Relief for Tyler Adams (Bournemouth) as the ref sticks to his original yellow card decision after the VAR review.
59' Wait! The referee makes the VAR signal and he's going to review that incident from earlier. This could be a red card for Tyler Adams (Bournemouth)! Let's see what he decides.
58' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Tyler Adams (Bournemouth) was quite harsh and Jarred Gillett didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
58' The game is interrupted. Granit Xhaka (Sunderland) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
56' Marcos Senesi (Bournemouth) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Jarred Gillett blows his whistle for a foul.
52' Bournemouth enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.

47' Habib Diarra (Sunderland) runs onto a loose pass inside the box and releases a tremendous shot towards the middle of the goal. However, Djordje Petrovic anticipates the shot and makes a decent save.
47' Chemsdine Talbi (Sunderland) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Djordje Petrovic intercepts the ball.
46' Andoni Iraola has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Evanilson (Bournemouth) comes on the pitch for David Brooks.
46' The second half has just started.
45+3' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+2' Eli Junior Kroupi (Bournemouth) receives a well-played pass inside the penalty area and shoots. He sends the ball into orbit.
45+1' David Brooks (Bournemouth) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender.
45+1' Rayan (Bournemouth) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Bournemouth.
45' 2 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
44' Alex Scott (Bournemouth) whips in the resulting set piece but it's cleared.

44' It looks like Chemsdine Talbi (Sunderland) saw red with that tackle. Jarred Gillett won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul. Bournemouth are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
42' The corner from Granit Xhaka (Sunderland) is cleared away by the defence.

42' Enzo Le Fee (Sunderland) collects a pass from the flank, looks up and fires in a goal-bound shot from the edge of the box which canons off a defender to safety. Sunderland force their opponents to concede a corner.
40' David Brooks (Bournemouth) fails to find a teammate across the pitch with a long ball.
38' Daniel Ballard (Sunderland) jumps into a tackle and Jarred Gillett signals a foul.
36' James Hill (Bournemouth) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Robin Roefs, who smothers the ball.
35' Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth) sends in a direct shot from a dangerously positioned free kick. The ball sails towards the left post, but the goalkeeper prevents a goal with a quick save.
33' Noah Sadiki (Sunderland) fouls his opponent and receives a yellow card from the referee, but he is clearly not happy with the decision.

33' Robin Roefs pulls off a great save to deny Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth) after receiving a precise defence-splitting pass. The effort is headed for the left side of the goal, but the goalkeeper dives superbly to stop it. Definitely the best save of this match so far!
32' Jarred Gillett blows his whistle as Eli Junior Kroupi (Bournemouth) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.

31' Nice move, nice attempt! Alex Scott (Bournemouth) is teed up with a simple pass after a nice flowing move. His first time shot from mid-range looks like it's going in but curls just wide of the right post.
29' Alejandro Jimenez (Bournemouth) wins the ball after the corner kick and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by one of the defending players.
29' David Brooks (Bournemouth) works the corner short.
28' Alex Scott (Bournemouth) picks up a rebound inside the penalty area and drills a shot to the middle of the goal, but is denied by a reflex save from Robin Roefs.

28' Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth) receives a clever pass and shoots from mid-range. His shot looks like it's going in the bottom left corner, but Robin Roefs has other ideas and makes a brilliant save.
27' The resulting free kick from Granit Xhaka (Sunderland) ends up in the gloves of the keeper.
27' A clumsy foul by Marcos Senesi (Bournemouth) and Jarred Gillett blows his whistle. Sunderland are awarded a free kick.
25' A snap shot from distance by Alejandro Jimenez (Bournemouth) after a precise pass is brilliantly blocked by a defender.
24' Alex Scott (Bournemouth) attempts to find a teammate with the corner, but the effort is snuffed out by the goalkeeper.
24' Alejandro Jimenez (Bournemouth) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. The referee signals a corner kick to Bournemouth.
23' Rayan (Bournemouth) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
18' 0 - 1 Goal 0:1! Eliezer Mayenda (Sunderland) taps home from close range after the rebound fell kindly into his path.

18' Habib Diarra (Sunderland) gets on the end of a defence splitting pass inside the box and immediately directs a low shot towards the middle of the goal, but the Djordje Petrovic makes a great save.
16' Jarred Gillett couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Tyler Adams (Bournemouth) and blew his whistle.
15' Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth) commits an ugly tackle on his opponent, but there is no caution from the referee.
13' Bournemouth take a quick free kick and immediately restart play.
13' Noah Sadiki (Sunderland) tackles a bit over-zealously and Jarred Gillett blows for a foul. Bournemouth win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
12' Eli Junior Kroupi (Bournemouth) beats the defender to the ball in the box and shoots, but the ball flashes just wide of the left post.
11' Eli Junior Kroupi (Bournemouth) takes the corner with a short pass.
10' David Brooks (Bournemouth) sends a pass into the penalty area, but the opponent manages to cut it out. Now Bournemouth have a corner.
8' Granit Xhaka (Sunderland) swings the ball into the box from the corner kick but it's a bit too strong and it goes out of play.
8' Enzo Le Fee (Sunderland) floats the free kick into the box, but it's easily cleared by the first man. It will be a corner kick for Sunderland.

7' Alex Scott (Bournemouth) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Jarred Gillett with no other option than to blow for a foul. Free kick. Sunderland will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
5' A cross from the free kick is whipped in by Granit Xhaka (Sunderland), but one of the defenders steps in and averts the threat.
4' Enzo Le Fee (Sunderland) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.

3' Djordje Petrovic makes a brilliant save! Noah Sadiki (Sunderland) easily weaves through the defence and unleashes a shot from just outside of the box. His effort goes towards the bottom left corner but is saved by the keeper!
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
The players are out at last! Sunderland will take the kick-off.
Jarred Gillett is introduced as the referee for today's match.
